items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When I heard him play he was with Babs’s Three Bips and a Bop

ctx.x: Right, exactly, especially when he changed. I mean, I never heard him play when he was with the Sultans. When I heard him play he was with Babs’s Three Bips and a Bop on those Blue Note recordings that he did. But it was the tenor saxophone that inspired me. Like I said, my two favorites were Lester Young and Dexter Gordon. Then
when I heard Charlie Parker, that really made me realize that I could keep the alto and be happy.
